findings.passage: You must have a state issued photo ID to vote.
findings.note: Release from his House office urging turnout for the August 8, 2023 special election; it tells voters a state-issued photo ID is needed to vote. The same release quotes him on Issue 1 (initiative-petition threshold), which is not about ID.

findings.passage: Ohio is currently facing a shortage of poll-workers which, in turn, makes the voting process more difficult for citizens.
findings.note: Release on HB 180 (job protection for poll workers), introduced with another member. Related election-administration statement, not about ID or citizenship.
